Bing Wallpaper
Originally a feature in Microsoft's Bing Search,The background of the homepage of Bing Search is a different wallpaper every day, the best in terms of aesthetics among the search engines.A separate app went live around March 2020 Bing Wallpaper

en-us.ui_friendlink_wallpaper_2:
ChiYuan Api || t.alcy.cc
ChiYua ApiA free for the public a variety of gallery type of personal picture Api, and no donation method (now almost 7TB / month of data access)
en-us.ui_friendlink_weathercategory_0:
Free API || SteamUser@Guooo
A replacement API published by Steam user @Guooo on the original wallpaper discussion page. He paid for the Amap enterprise API and had too many quota points so he made it public.
en-us.ui_friendlink_weathercategory_1:
QWeather API || qweather.com
A weather provider with global deployment and support for 30+ languages. It was formerly known as HeWeather and officially renamed QWeather on October 12, 2020. It also has its own standalone App, QWeather
en-us.ui_friendlink_weathercategory_2:
TianQi API || tianqiapi.com
A weather provider with a diverse range of clients, including major companies such as Huawei, Apple, multiple government websites, and more.
en-us.ui_friendlink_weathercategory_3:
Visual Crossing API || visualcrossing.com
A comprehensive API with a large volume of data supports global weather (although some regions may be occupied by regions with the same name, which can be troublesome), historical weather, multi-language support, automatic unit conversion, and multiple data types in one API request, such as: request 15-day daily weather, 24-hour hourly forecasts, current weather, meteorological disaster warnings, and meteorological events. It can be said that it is very powerful, and has a daily limit of 10,000 requests.
en-us.ui_friendlink_weathercategory_4:
Open Meteo ApI || open-meteo.com
An Open Historical Weather API With Multiple Regional Weather Sources
